items.prompt: A single tall vertical illustration of a peaceful green valley for a children's Islamic learning app, in exactly the same glossy Pixar-like 3D cartoon style, soft warm sunlight, saturated friendly colours and clean modelling as the reference images. Top 12% of the image must be calm sky only. Lower-left and centre foreground: open soft grass and a gentle path, empty. HARD CONTENT RULES: absolutely no people, no humans, no hands, no animals, no birds, no insects, no fish, no faces (not even on the sun, moon, clouds, stars or objects), no text, no letters, no numerals, no calligraphy, no symbols that look like writing, no logos, no watermark, no brand or known cartoon characters.
